chapter: Rhythm Club memories and playing technique
title: Showman bass player in Cab's band whose name he can't recall

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Very nice, great showman. Great showman. People used to just watch him. Another great showman bass player that Milt Hinton took his place with Cab Calloway, what was his name? Oh that's a shame.
My discography doesn't go back that far. Let's see if it's in Chilton..
I know it too, I've heard it.

Well anyway I'll think of it after I finish tell you this story. Getting back to show business, showmanship--it almost came to me there. He used to sit in Cab's band, he was the bass player with Cab, and used to spin his bass around, and his eyes would bulge and things like that and people really used to look at him when Cab Calloway's band would be appearing anywheres, theaters, anywheres. Well if they played a theater, what he would do when the curtain would close, he would jump off the bandstand and run out front and stand in the lobby so people could say, there he is, there's the bass player. What is his name? I'll think of it before we finish.
